acceptanceCriteria: internal/tasks/cli is measured on a host where its tests pass unconfined (a CI runner is acceptable), and either declared with a zero-new-miss replay or given a reason naming its unbounded read.
The three analyzerpython reads are identified and either declared or recorded as the unit's reason.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0868 lane (2026-10-06). internal/tasks/cli (hosted estimate about 184 s, selected on every Go change) could not be measured: 264 of its tests fail in the golang:1.27.1 container even unconfined. internal/analyzerpython has three tests that fail confined even with its import closure declared (TestCoreDependencyClosureExcludesPythonCandidate, TestLiteralPinnedBeamfallPythonFixtures, TestPerformanceRatchets), so it has reads not yet identified.
title: Measure the read scopes of internal/tasks/cli and internal/analyzerpython
